jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

 

What you’ll do

As an Electrical Engineering Intern, you will work alongside senior hardware engineers to help expand our autonomous transport platforms.

jobs.title: Safety Engineering Manager - Mining Deployments
jobs.description_text:
Who we are

Pronto AI is a global leader in commercializing autonomous vehicle (AV) technology, deploying Autonomous Haulage Systems (AHS) that automate operations in mines, quarries, and construction sites worldwide. While much of the industry remains in R&D, we deliver real, production-ready autonomy that is already operating in the field.

We are on a mission to make mining operations safer, smarter, and more efficient through cutting-edge technology, and we are building toward becoming the world’s first profitable AV technology company.

 

What you’ll do

  • Build the off-road truck safety case. Claims, evidence, limits, and what remains open. Keep it current as trucks, sites and software change, and be clear about what it does not cover.
  • Hazard analysis. What the installation introduces on a given truck, what the site already carries, and what the combination creates. Drive the results into requirements and into site controls.
  • Test preparation. Define what has to be demonstrated before a truck operates autonomously at a site: the procedures, the acceptance criteria, and what evidence each test actually produces.

Who we are

In the past, to be a successful restaurateur, you simply had to have a passion for food and a passion for people — but to succeed as a digital restaurateur you also need to have a passion for technology.   • Design offboarding and lifecycle cleanup

Our platform coordinates and collects terabytes of data from what will soon be more than 1,000,000 distributed energy devices, such as thermostats, electric vehicles and home batteries. 

Coordinating and evaluating the performance of all of these devices to forecast and estimate the delivered grid value requires state-of-the-art data science, control systems and machine learning. As such, EnergyHub seeks to hire an Energy Data Scientist to join EnergyHub’s Analytics Engineering team. As an Energy Data Scientist you will work closely with other data scientists and analytics engineers to improve the models used for evaluation of our control algorithms. You will collaborate with the Data Science and Power Systems Intelligence team to understand the algorithms and optimizations used in order to improve our performance evaluation and forecasting abilities. You will also contribute to our data management software systems and will become core to the foundation of a future with carbon-free and distributed energy.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description_text:
The Problem to solve

Utility systems weren't built to connect seamlessly with a DER platform. CIS holds the customer record, while ADMS and Grid DERMS drive real-time grid decisions. Each system operates with its own data model, security posture, and review process. You will be the key leader who transforms that fragmentation into a coherent, streamlined integration strategy.

The Role

As the Lead Product Manager, you will own how EnergyHub connects and integrates with utility operational systems, ensuring we understand our mutual end-customers (CIS), manage distribution grid conditions (OT systems), and unlock automation opportunities that drive value. This is a focused mandate where you will own the utility-facing integration surface end to end. Over time, your team will leverage internal APIs built by core platform teams to solve the "last-mile" challenge, building a robust set of outward connectors and an ecosystem of software vendors and system integration partners.

This role reports to a Director of Product and will collaborate with stakeholders across the company, including other product managers, engineers, data scientists, sales, solutions engineering, and client success.

jobs.description_text:
Evolver builds enterprise AI that works inside some of the most demanding functions in large organizations, including tax, finance, and procurement. Our customers make real decisions based on what our platform produces, so quality here is not a final checkpoint. It is part of the product.

We are seeking a hands-on Senior QA Lead to define how Evolver tests, measures, and ships with confidence. You will lead our QA team in India, currently two engineers, and help grow it to five over the coming months. You will partner closely with GenAI Engineering, Product, and our Forward Deployed Engineers to build a quality practice that covers traditional application testing as well as the harder questions that come with AI: consistency, accuracy, regressions in model behavior, and how a system performs on messy, real customer data.

This role is well suited for an experienced QA leader who still enjoys writing tests, wants to shape a function rather than inherit one, and is curious about what quality engineering looks like for AI products.

  • Own Evolver's end to end quality strategy across our enterprise AI platform and customer deployments.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE SITE
Anduril is a leader in autonomous systems and weapons manufacturing, is building Arsenal-1, its first hyperscale manufacturing facility, just south of Columbus, Ohio in Pickaway County. Arsenal-1 is redefining the scale and speed that autonomous systems and weapons can be produced for the United States and its allies and partners. This is a monumental and essential step toward rebuilding America’s defense industrial base, strengthening America’s warfighting capabilities, and enhancing deterrence amid rising international threats.
